who.text: With 450 ten-seat shuttles, pooled over 3 simulated weekdays, 92% of rides reach their stop sooner than by bus, comparing each ride with one simulated bus wait (94% beat the bus's average time for that trip). The average saving is 5.2 minutes. Longer rides gain more: 78% of all rides under 0.5 km are faster, against 97% of all rides over 1.5 km, where bus routes loop and stop more often than a direct shuttle. After 20:00, when buses run less often, 98% are faster; in the 07:00–09:00 peak, 78%. The slowest tenth of shuttle rides take more than 10.5 min, against 19.7 min by bus (12.9 against 17.3 min in the 07:00–09:00 peak). Of the rides that are slower by shuttle, 18% are under 0.5 km; in 94% the shuttle wait is longer than the bus wait, and in 18% the shuttle ride is longer than the bus ride.
who.headline: Longer rides inside the town gain most; the shortest hops gain least
